question: Does my business have a file on Qiwa, with the right address and branches?
Is my business registered with GOSI?
if_no: No access to GOSI services such as the GOSI certificate and GOSI Online (DOC22-R002); no fine stated in the record

question: Is every employee's contract on Qiwa?
if_no: Fine 300 / 500 / 1,000 SAR per worker (size C / B / A); a Saudi worker without a documented contract is not counted in Nitaqat

question: Is every employee registered with GOSI?
where_to_check: GOSI Online: List of Establishment Contributors (DOC22-R008)
if_no: Fines for late or refused registration; the worker may register himself
na_allowed_when: No worker meets GOSI coverage conditions (DOC18-R008)

question: Is each employee's salary entered correctly in GOSI?
where_to_check: GOSI Online: Inquire about the annual wages (DOC22-R009); subscriber wage details
if_no: Penalties and fines for missing, late or wrong wage data
na_allowed_when: No worker is registered with GOSI (DOC18-R007)

question: Is every Saudi on my GOSI list really working for me?
where_to_check: GOSI Online: List of Establishment Contributors (DOC22-R008), compared with my actual staff
if_no: Fine 5,000 / 8,000 / 15,000 SAR per person (size C / B / A); GOSI fine up to 50,000 SAR or double the contributions, whichever is greater

question: Do my business and every employee have a bank account?
if_no: Salary file can't be uploaded or bank processing fails; wages can't be paid and WPS violations are recorded
na_allowed_when: Not subject to the Wage Protection Program (DOC03-R002)

question: Is the person who uploads salaries registered with the Ministry as a Mudad user?
if_no: That person cannot upload salary files
na_allowed_when: Not subject to the Wage Protection Program (DOC03-R002)

question: Did I upload the salary file to Mudad every month, at the compliance rate the Ministry sets?
where_to_check: Mudad: wage protection dashboard and compliance rate
if_no: Fine 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 SAR (size C / B / A), for not uploading or for uploading below the compliance rate
na_allowed_when: Not subject to the Wage Protection Program (DOC03-R002)

question: Have I paid all my GOSI bills on time?
where_to_check: GOSI Online: View establishment bill, paid through SADAD (DOC22-R016, R017)
if_no: Fine of 2% of the amount due for each month late

question: Do I let GOSI inspectors see my work, staff and salary records?
where_to_check: My own records; GOSI inspection notices
if_no: Fine up to 50,000 SAR, doubled if repeated
na_allowed_when: Never: every employer under the Social Insurance Law (DOC18-R017)

question: Do I have enough Saudi employees for my business type?
if_no: Fine 2,000 / 4,000 / 6,000 SAR (size C / B / A) for each non-Saudi worker above the ratio
na_allowed_when: None of its professions or activities has a Saudization decision (DOC03-R005)
